title: Drawer: push the panes aside, docs as a tree, read docs in a full-screen markdown viewer
notes:
Follow-up to PR #161, from using it.

1. Layout: the open drawer pushes the page to the right, the panes resize; it no longer lies over them. Closed, it takes no room.
2. Docs as a tree: directories are rows that open and close (arrow keys, Enter, and the usual Left/Right to collapse and expand), not every file listed flat. The filter still finds files across closed directories.
3. Opening a doc: Enter or a click shows the file rendered as markdown in a full-screen viewer, the way a click on an image in the chat opens it full screen, so it reads properly (tables, code, images). Esc closes it. A row at the top, Edit, opens the file in the project's nvim; it is reachable from the keyboard too.
